articles.title: Partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities in OpenAI’s systems
articles.description: OpenAI is partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities, test connections with third-party services, and strengthen defenses with frontier AI.
articles.full_text:
Title: Partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities in OpenAI’s systems

URL Source: https://openai.com/index/partnering-with-hacktron

Final URL: https://openai.com/index/partnering-with-hacktron/

Markdown Content:
Today we’re announcing a partnership with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities in OpenAI’s systems. Our engineers and Hacktron’s security researchers will choose high-priority areas to test together, with a focus on how our systems interact with third-party services. As part of the partnership, we’re expanding Hacktron’s access to our frontier models through [Daybreak Red](https://openai.com/index/expanding-daybreak-as-the-cyber-defense-window-narrows/).

As we work to accelerate cyber defense with frontier AI, we’re applying the same urgency to finding and fixing vulnerabilities in our own systems. Earlier this week, we announced that [Cathedral’s researchers will work alongside our teams in our next security sprint](https://openai.com/index/preparing-our-next-security-sprint-to-harden-openai/). We also [raised our bug bounty rewards](https://openai.com/index/rewarding-defenders-with-bigger-bug-bounties/) to give independent researchers more reason to pursue vulnerabilities our own testing may have missed.

We became familiar with Hacktron through our Security Bug Bounty program and were impressed by the impact of the vulnerabilities its researchers have discovered and disclosed to us. The team builds AI agents for code review, penetration testing, and red teaming. Their [research⁠(opens in a new window)](https://www.hacktron.ai/blog) has uncovered vulnerabilities in how applications, cloud infrastructure, and identity systems interact. Their work shows what’s possible when security engineers build around AI to move faster and take on more ambitious research.

As AI agents connect services in new ways, that combination of skills becomes even more valuable. Working alongside Hacktron will help us test those connections more deeply and use what we learn to strengthen our defenses.

We’re grateful to Hacktron and other independent researchers who put time into finding and reporting weaknesses to help strengthen the security that protects all our users. To see which systems are in scope or submit a finding, visit our [Security Bug Bounty program⁠(opens in a new window)](https://bugcrowd.com/engagements/openai).

New Anthropic research: Automating subtle emergent misalignment research.

articles.description:
New Anthropic research: Automating subtle emergent misalignment research.

Red-teaming is a vital part of model safety testing, but it’s also limited by researchers’ time. To see if we could automate it, we set thousands of Claude agents the task of evading a training data monitor.

These agents developed training data that looked harmless to monitors (like a veteran wrestler mentoring a newcomer, or a Q&A about professional beekeeping), but that in fact taught misaligned behavior.

Examples like these can be used to directly improve future training data monitors. This research is only a first step, but it suggests that future red-teaming efforts could improve much further, using better models and more compute.

Read the full post on the Alignment Science Blog: https://t.co/24Gs1oSw7Q

articles.title: For AGI to benefit all of humanity, it should help people with the everyday tasks that matter most to them. So we built LifeVal, a new benchmark shaped by feedback from thousands of ChatGPT users on w
articles.description:
For AGI to benefit all of humanity, it should help people with the everyday tasks that matter most to them. So we built LifeVal, a new benchmark shaped by feedback from thousands of ChatGPT users on where they most want help from a personal assistant—from finding childcare to accessing government services to managing personal finances.

Over the past year, we’ve used LifeVal to measure and improve how well our models handle these everyday tasks.

https://t.co/GlUjixzEM0
articles.linked_content:
Title: LifeVal

URL Source: https://openai.com/index/lifeval/

Markdown Content:
OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. For the more than one billion people who currently use ChatGPT every week, we want to build AI that can help with the practical challenges of everyday life, like finding childcare, accessing government services, creating a budget, preparing for school, modifying recipes, ordering groceries, designing workout plans, and more.

When someone is looking for help making their life easier, they need more than advice or a chat response. To be a truly helpful personal assistant, ChatGPT should be able to take actions that actually get things done.

LifeVal video showing everyday tasks including shopping, caregiving, moving, and reading with a child.

To measure model performance over time on everyday tasks, we built an evaluation of tasks covering areas where users wanted the most help from AI and personal agents. We used this evaluation to track and drive improvement in model performance on everyday tasks over the past year.

## Background

To identify the tasks people value most, we started with two large studies that track how people spend time in both the U.S. and internationally: the [American Time Use Survey⁠(opens in a new window)](https://www.bls.gov/tus/) and the [Multinational Time Use Study⁠(opens in a new window)](https://www.timeuse.org/mtus). Together, these datasets provide a detailed catalog of everyday life tasks that people do across different demographics, times of day, and seasons. To understand where people would most value AI assistance, we expanded on these existing surveys with a new demographically representative survey of 3,995 respondents. For each task, we asked a variety of questions to identify the areas where everyday people most wanted help from a personal assistant. The resulting tasks span the most important areas that people want help with, including caregiving, health, education, household administration, personal finances, shopping, and accessing government services.

## Individual task examples

Below are some examples of how our current models perform on practical workflows from everyday life.

### Enroll in the right kindergarten after moving

93.1%

![Image 1](https://images.ctfassets.net/kftzwdyauwt9/0PsOKDe2IX2yO0sZVTxNn/d1de90b42ea9c430a6910aaf9e4f731b/bus.png?w=3840&q=90&fm=webp)

Compare kindergartens near our new home and shortlist the best fits.

I’ve narrowed it to three kindergartens and organized the enrollment details. Two preferences still need your call. Want to review the shortlist?

### Manage volunteers ahead of a flood

98.0%

![Image 2](https://images.ctfassets.net/kftzwdyauwt9/1hDPV5I4BneWeWnKWVsAvs/6bdf8f993cbedc6b20dc2a03c8824dce/water-drop-dingbat.png?w=3840&q=90&fm=webp)

Help me organize our community’s flood preparation volunteer force for four neighbors needing floodproofing assistance.

I’ve prepared a simple action plan to help volunteers assess the sites mentioned and help them prepare for upcoming severe weather.

### Find a new home for my family

100%

![Image 3](https://images.ctfassets.net/kftzwdyauwt9/4p9ZKTfC9iNi5m1xXkMCQl/ffdff61608bbc569e5bfa647c1a38c84/welcome-mat-white-cropped.png?w=3840&q=90&fm=webp)

Find a home in Luzerne County that fits my budget, has a separate living unit, and keeps my commute short after school drop-off. Add the deed to my cart so I can review it.

I found one home that meets your requirements. I’ve calculated the transfer tax and added the deed to your country records cart to review.

### Watch a game with grandma from far away

96.3%

![Image 4](https://images.ctfassets.net/kftzwdyauwt9/1EixydflAQZXI6yTNaL6Zg/6cc1f7086d118c3853f3a8c83da589fb/football.png?w=3840&q=90&fm=webp)

Set up an easy way for grandma and me to watch the game together remotely.

The easiest watch setup is ready, with a backup if the stream fails. Want me to walk you through it with grandma?

### Meal prep for a parent adjusting to a new diabetes diagnosis

90.4%

![Image 5](https://images.ctfassets.net/kftzwdyauwt9/7cn1KRGTQUsctQue7wawds/5be11f2e14bffbcb227e0ee375f5529e/cart.png?w=3840&q=90&fm=webp)

Help my parent adjust to a new diabetes diagnosis with a practical care and meal plan.

The first-week plan is ready, including meals, reminders, and questions for the care team. Want to review it together before you share it with your parent?

Our latest models score very highly on many LifeVal tasks.See more

Over the past year, we’ve trained our models to become much faster, more capable, and more aligned on browser use, computer use, and connectors tasks. Enabling these capabilities in ChatGPT also expands the types of tasks the model can help with, helping move ChatGPT beyond a chat tool and towards a truly agentic personal assistant.

To ensure AGI benefits all of humanity, we need to measure and improve model progress on what matters in the lives of everyday people. That means going beyond academic assessments of model knowledge and actually measuring how well AI models can help people navigate decisions, manage everyday responsibilities, and get meaningful things done. We are hopeful that LifeVal represents a step towards that goal.

Building with the Agents API? 

Here's what we shipped this week for you:
articles.description:
Building with the Agents API? 

Here's what we shipped this week for you:

quoted_tweet.author: stevendcoffey
quoted_tweet.text:
🗣️ The Agents API team has a shipping problem – we literally cannot stop. Here’s what we cooked up for you beautiful people this week:

💂 Auto Review: Just like in codex, auto-review will evaluate commands for potential bad behavior before executing.

🗜️ Async Compaction: Speed up your sessions by allowing compaction to happen in the background.

🕐 Time awareness: An experimental feature that allows the model to have a sense of time passing. This means the model will better act on queries like, ”timebox CI fixes to 10 minutes.”

🔨 Tool Updates: You can now update a session’s tools at any time.

💰 Better prompt-cache awareness: System prompts are now automatically cached across all sessions, saving you money and time
